actions.action: Scoop off the top 1 cm of mouldy soil and discard it
Wipe white fuzz off the trunk base with a cotton swab dipped in rubbing alcohol
Lift the plant out of the decorative bowl and pour out standing water
Tip out excess water 15 minutes after each watering
Check soil moisture 3 cm deep with a finger before watering, and water only when dry
Move the plant to the brightest window with some air movement

reason: The answer correctly blames overly wet soil for the mould, but it only removes the top layer and adjusts watering instead of replacing the soil as the poster did; nothing it suggests is harmful.
